name: gemini-web-mcp
description: Connect Claude to Google Gemini. Chat, generate images (Nano Banana Pro / Nano Banana 2), videos (Gemini Omni), music (Lyria 3.5), deep research, manage gems, and more.
long_description:
This extension connects Claude Desktop to Google Gemini via the Model Context Protocol. It provides 10 tools for chat, image/video/music generation, deep research, gems management, canvas, code execution, file uploads, and usage limits.

**Prerequisites:**
1. Install the package: `pip install gemini-web-mcp-cli` or `uv tool install gemini-web-mcp-cli`
2. Authenticate: Run `gemcli login` to set up your Google account

**Features:**
- Chat with Gemini models (3.8 Flash, 3.1 Pro, 4 Argon; thinking levels; Chat/Task)
- Generate images with Nano Banana Pro / Nano Banana 2 (explicit aspect ratios)
- Generate videos with Gemini Omni (landscape/portrait, model tiers, templates)
- Generate music with Lyria 3.5 (length, vocals, genre, templates)
- Deep research with citations
- Create and manage Gems (custom personas)
- Canvas and code execution
- File uploads (images, PDFs, audio, video)
- Check usage limits and quotas (credit pool, per-account profiles)
